Through: Ms. Priyanka Dalal, APP  SI Suraj, PS Mehrauli  Mr. Gagan Bhunaria, Adv  (R-2 thru VC)
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 20.01.2023 Exemption allowed subject to all just exceptions.
1.

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.341/2016 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Mehrauli on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide Settlement Deed dated 9th April, 2017 arrived at between them with the facilitation of Counseling Cell, Family Courts, Saket, Delhi, which is on record of this Court.
2.

entities.text: Counseling Cell, Family Courts, Saket, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: As per the FIR, petitioner no.1 was married to respondent no.2 on 13th July, 2005 but due to disputes and differences, the marriage was dissolved by mutual consent vide decree of divorce dated 10th October, 2018.
No child was born out of this wedlock.
3. As per settlement, balance sum of Rs.2 lakhs is tendered to be respondent No.2.
Same is handed over to the learned counsel for the respondent No.2, who is present in the Court today, by way of a Demand Draft No.528673 dated 12th January, 2023 drawn on SBI.
. Same is duly received and acknowledged on behalf of respondent No.2 towards full and final settlement of all her claims.

4. Considering the above settlement between the parties and chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use to continue with proceeding of the present FIR as the complainant has settled all disputes with the petitioner.
Consequently, the aforementioned FIR and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
5. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
6. Order be uploaded on website of this Court.
